job_posting.title: Junior Financial Operations Associate (Tokyo Office)
job_posting.description_plain:
On-site financial entry and invoice processing in our Tokyo headquarters.

Workplace Location & Visa Sponsorship Policy:
- Physical on-site attendance at Tokyo office required (Employer Workplace Location Policy).
- Employer Visa Policy: The employer does not provide visa sponsorship or Certificate of Eligibility (COE) processing for this role. Candidates must possess existing independent legal authorization to work in Japan (e.g. Permanent Resident, Spouse/Child of Japanese National, or active valid Status of Residence with change-of-employer eligibility under Japan Immigration Services Agency guidelines) prior to hire.
- Fluent Japanese and basic accounting knowledge.

mandatory_constraints: Mandatory on-site attendance at Tokyo office (Employer Location Policy)
Existing independent Japan work authorization (Employer No-Visa-Sponsorship Policy)

education_status.status_stated: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science

experience.title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer
experience.description: Architected low-latency transaction processing APIs in Python (FastAPI) and TypeScript (React), deployed on AWS ECS with PostgreSQL.

evidence_facts.statement: 6 years full-stack Python/FastAPI, TypeScript, and AWS cloud engineering.

intended_evaluation_purpose: Fails employer workplace & visa policy: role requires existing independent Japan work authorization (employer does not provide COE visa sponsorship).
